title: MD Study Room Central Update Manifest Schema
description: Defines the canonical structure for remote update manifests consumed by MD Study Room v1.9+

appId.description: Unique identifier for the MD Study Room application

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of manifest publication

minAppVersion.description: Minimum client app version required to ingest items from this manifest

releaseNotes.description: Optional human-readable release notes for this publication

appDownloadUrl.description: Optional URL where users can download the updated standalone HTML or package

subjectId.description: Subject identifier matching Pharm-D curriculum (e.g. biopharm, clinical, industrial, quality, hospital)

contentVersion.description: Monotonically increasing version number for this content item

title.description: Human-readable title displayed in the update inspector

changeLog.description: Concise summary of updates, additions, or errata in this release

fileUrl.description: Direct HTTP/HTTPS download URL for the authentic JSON payload

fileSizeBytes.description: Exact byte size of the downloaded payload

isMandatory.description: Indicates whether the update is mandatory or recommended
